_comment: Registry for the payout / AR / commission flow (/project-costs-sync, /payout-run). Every Notion data source id and EXACT property name the finance scripts read or write lives here, never in a script or a prompt. Verified live (read-only) 2026-10-05 against the Notion API; formula CODE is hidden by the API, so formula text Albert must paste lives in methods/payouts.md, not here.
_maintenance: Property names are EXACT MATCH, including trailing spaces (Project Costs `Project ID ` has one). A renamed property silently reads as empty — re-verify with notion-fetch on the data source before changing a name here. Fields marked `"status": "to_add"` do not exist yet; Albert adds them (Workstream B in methods/payouts.md) and flips the marker to `live`. Scripts treat a `to_add` field as absent and degrade, never error.
_sensitivity_note: Project Financials and commission figures are admin-grade (vault CONVENTIONS: Project Financials facts are admin). Payout run output is never routed to a staff-visible destination.

properties.title: Description
properties._value_note: Final contract total, tax-inclusive on Invoice deals, ALREADY post-discount: payments summed to it exactly on PP-461, PP-450, PP-417.
properties._pm_note: Use the person field. `PM Name` (select) is empty on 37 of the 40 most recent rows — never read it.

properties.title: Name
properties._calculated_note: Untrustworthy as 'cost entered': ticked on Non-Flooring Materials rows with no cost. Never read it as a completeness signal.
properties._paid_reference_note: Historically free text ('emt', 'ok', 'LS', 'Taken off from owing'). The batch stamps a real reference from now on.

project_costs._revenue_rule: Only NFM (and flooring line) rows carry revenue. Labor, disposal, delivery and other rows carry cost only — their revenue is inside the customer total (Albert amendment §2.1).
project_costs._nfm_rule: NFM rows keep today's meaning (Albert 2026-10-06): `Cost` = the full Lightspeed POS total incl. tax for the project's PP-tagged sales; commission adds the fixed 25% estimate. The sync fills that number; no new NFM fields.
project_costs._sync_owned_note: The sync may overwrite `Cost` only when `Cost source` is one of these (or empty). A hand-entered source is never overwritten (plan Workstream C step 4).

ap_disposal._note: The Titan Team row a Disposal cost is paid to and that `Assign Disposal` points at for AP Disposal jobs (verified 2026-10-06: PP-450's Disposal row, $279.34 = AP invoice 2406).

project_financials._match_rule: Find a project's Financials row by the `Project` relation, NEVER by title. Live titles are 'Description (Financials)' with no PP id, and two 'Diego (Financials)' rows link to older projects.
project_financials._paste_by_hand_note: Open Work Orders, Commission Releasable and Submit Blockers were pasted by Albert in the Notion UI on 2026-10-06 (the API rejects formulas that read through a relation). payout_run.py still computes the work-order hold itself.

flooring_line_items._qty_check_note: Albert 2026-10-08: front desk owns the 'Quantities to verify' view (Albert helps). The sync sets OK / Verify - ...; only a person sets Verified - ..., and the sync never changes a Verified value. The Verified answer decides the job's sqft and cost: from stock -> Sqft Sold = sold, cost blends the invoiced part with the LS average cost for the stock part; leftover to stock -> Sqft Sold = sold at the invoice rate; used on job / OK -> invoice figures stand.
flooring_line_items._tax_basis_note: Albert 2026-10-06: Cost Rate, Sold At Rate and every *Cost Rate column hold PRE-TAX $/sqft, as the Data Entry Cheat Sheet says (the formulas add x1.13) and as existing rows already do (PP-449 SPC-VIDR-0002_Yukon Cost Rate 1.59 = Vidar's pre-tax price). The Notion descriptions on Cost Rate / Sold At Rate were changed to say pre-tax the same day.
flooring_line_items._title_note: Staff name a line '<LS SKU>_<colour>' (SPC-VIDR-0002_Yukon, ENG-TOSC-0074_Long Beach). The sync creates lines the same way (colour = the bracketed name in the LS product name) and matches an existing line on the part before the first '_'.
flooring_line_items._material_company_note: LS supplier name -> Material Company option, exact options only; a supplier not listed leaves the field blank for the PM. Add an entry when another supplier's documents are read.
flooring_line_items._flooring_sku_prefixes_note: A PP-tagged PO line with one of these catalogue SKU prefixes is a flooring product even when no supplier document or Lightspeed sale names it (PP-451: LAM-EVGR-72740 on a PO, no sale). Such a line is proposed, never written, until Sqft Sold is known.

quoted_sqft.name: Quoted Sqft
quoted_sqft._note: The PM's sqft as quoted (an approximation until the Airtable quote uses real box sizes). Never written by the sync.

qty_note.name: Qty Note
qty_note._note: Front desk's finding. The sync writes an 'Auto:' hint only into an empty note.

properties.title: Details
properties._message_note: Holds the payer's memo, which often contains a customer street address and phone. Read for matching; never echo into logs, plans or reports.
properties._deposit_account_note: Which bank account the e-transfer landed in (Albert 2026-10-07). Codes in deposit_account_codes below; business_account_codes are Titan's own. A payment in any other account is money to transfer into Titan before the project's Lightspeed sale is closed (procedure to come).

master_payments_log._business_account_note: Albert 2026-10-07: BMO is the business account; the rest are personal.

titan_team._placeholder_note: Rows that are not real payees. A cost assigned to one of these is flagged on the payout run, never paid.

pay_method.name: Pay Method
pay_method._owner: Albert sets this per contractor (2026-10-05). Netted is defined in methods/payouts.md before anyone uses it.

payout_batches._comment: Created 2026-10-06; moved by Albert to his private space the same day (admin-grade: payee totals and commission). One row per payee per run. Reverse relation on Project Costs is `Payout Batch`.

setup_views._comment: '💸 Payout Setup' views added 2026-10-06 on each database so the new fields can be seen together, and removed in one click.
